name: Lm-studio
tagline: Can run local AI models like gpt-oss, Llama, Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek privately on your computer.
description: LM Studio can run local AI models like gpt-oss, Llama, Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek privately on your computer.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/lm-studio:version-2026-09-12@sha256:29d2149a8046d54be16a9a3ae60568f63e6e886bed453d5884f8cfa93a3ac389
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
